title: Wso2am: Netty is an asynchronous event-driven network application framework for rapid development of maintainable high…
description: CVE-2024-47535 is a medium severity vulnerability affecting the wso2am package versions prior to 4.4.0-r1. It involves the Netty framework, which is used for asynchronous event-driven network application development. The vulnerability does not impact confidentiality or integrity but causes a high impact on availability. A patch is available in version 4.4.0-r1.
